Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning

Class GasCondensateInflowModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning.GasCondensateInflowModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GasCondensateInflowModel extends Object implements Serializable
Steady-state radial inflow of a gas-condensate well with condensate banking and non-Darcy flow.

The model follows the steady-state (Fevang and Whitson 1996 style) approach using the constant-composition relation of the wellstream. In molar terms the wellstream rate n_w obeys

Psi(p_e) - Psi(p_wf) = a n_w + b n_w^2, Psi(p) = integral of F(p) dp

  • a = (ln(r_e/r_w) - 0.75 + s) / (2 pi k h) (Darcy plus skin, pseudo-steady drainage)
  • b = k_rg beta M_g V (1/r_w - 1/r_e) / (4 pi^2 h^2 mu_g) evaluated at the well (Forchheimer term)
  • F(p) = k_rg rho_g / (mu_g V) with molar gas density rho_g, gas mole fraction V of the constant-composition flash and gas viscosity mu_g

Above the dew point k_rg is the endpoint k_rg,max, which for a dry gas reduces to the classical real-gas pseudo-pressure solution. Below the dew point the oil saturation is found from k_ro/k_rg = (L/V) rho_g mu_o / (rho_o mu_g) with Corey relative permeabilities (region 2); where the constant-composition liquid saturation is below the critical value the oil is immobile and the gas flows with k_rg at that saturation (region 3, CCE approximation).

Limitations: screening only. Fluid densities are NeqSim EOS densities (with the system volume correction, so the real-gas factor implied by density can differ from the raw EOS Z by about 0.5 percent). Velocity-dependent (capillary-number) relative permeability, composition change by depletion (CVD), water flow, layered or horizontal wells and transient banking build-up are not modelled. Validation is by the dry-gas pseudo-pressure analytic limit and by internal consistency (Forchheimer quadratic residual, monotonic banking impairment); no field data is used.
